items.heading: Two Students Can Graduate
items.text: Two students can graduate with what their certificates both call a "B.Sc Health Sciences" and walk into completely different jobs, one into a hospital radiology department, the other into a dietetics clinic, because the specific specialisation track inside the program differed. This is the single biggest thing to verify before enrolling anywhere, not after. If your specialisation is one of the named paramedical courses specifically, read Best Paramedical Courses and Scope in India for exact course duration, the NCAHP registration requirement, and entry-plus- senior pay for each one.

items.heading: Its Own Full Licensing
items.text: Its own full licensing and practice track, usually a dedicated BPT degree rather than a generalist health science elective.
